content.text:
=== frontend api base ===
frontend/.env.example:1:NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8000/api
=== env api ===
# forbiddenInProdRegex:/^http://localhost:3000,https://example.com$/ regex:/[^[:space:]]{5,}/
CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000,http://localhost:8000,http://localhost:3333,http://localhost:3000,http://localhost:8000,http://localhost:3333
# 🌍 URL the browser uses to call the backend API
# forbiddenInProdRegex:/^http://localhost:8000/api$/ regex:/[^[:space:]]{5,}$/
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8000/api
OI_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN="http://localhost:3000;http://localhost:3333;http://localhost:3000;http://localhost:3333"
VERSION_BACKEND=latest
# Path to the SQLite database file (inside the backend container)
FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:3000
# Internal container ports (the ports Docker binds inside the containers)
FRONTEND_PORT=3000
API_PORT=8000
# ClamAV daemon host/port used for malware scanning
CLAMAV_PORT=3310
SMTP_PORT=1025
# Open WebUI backend address (internal Docker service URL)
OPEN_WEBUI_PORT=3333
SWARM_PORT=4001
IPFS_API_PORT=5001
IPFS_GATEWAY_PORT=8080

observation.command: cd /workspace && grep -rn "path\|router.post\|router.get" backend/src/modules/users/presentation/users.routes.ts | head; echo "=== frontend api base ==="; grep -rn "API_URL\|NEXT_PUBLIC" frontend/.env* frontend/next.config* 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== env api ==="; grep -iE "API_URL|BACKEND|PORT|3000|8000" .env | head -20
